description.value: Juke is a popular fried chicken restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown, self-billed as Vancouver's number one fried chicken spot with a menu blending Southern and Asian influences — from Nuoc Cham ribs to jalapeño cheddar waffles. The adjoining Chickadee Room cocktail bar was recognized by Vancouver Magazine as the best Happy Hour in the city. A high-volume, independently operated spot open every day, it makes a solid refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the downtown core.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 50m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; rack (4 spaces) at 77m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Juke Fried Chicken at 182 Keefer St in Vancouver's Chinatown, matching the OSM address, and provides a phone number absent from OSM. Takeout is prominently featured throughout the site with a dedicated ordering flow, and the menu explicitly labels gluten-free items ('CHICKEN & WAFFLES (GF)', 'GF BUN AVAILABLE'). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
